Put P=A+t(B−A). Areas OAP and OBP scale as |t| and |1−t|. |1−t|=3|t| gives t=1/4 or −1/2. Their parameter gap is 3/4, and |AB|=4√5, so distance is 3√5.
Factor as (x²−(2a+3))(x²−(a−2))=0. For integer a: a≤−2 gives 0 roots; a=−1,0,1 gives 2; a=2 gives 3; a≥3 gives 4. Hence four integers yield f(a)∈{1,2,3}.

Solve f(x)−x=k. On x≥0 the parabola is x²−8x+6 with minimum −10 and value 6 at x=0; on x<0 it is x²+6x+6 with minimum −3 and limiting value 6 at 0. Four distinct intersections require −3<k<6. The integers −2,…,5 total 8.

Expression is squared distance to (4,0). On OA closest distance² is 8. On AB projection is interior and minimum distance² is 64/13. On BC projection is interior and minimum is 10; on CO closest point is C with distance² 20. Thus m=64/13; farthest vertex B or C has M=20. √(13(M−m))=√196=14.
The triangle is right at A; circumcenter is midpoint of BC=(4,5). Centroid is (3,11/3). Thus ab+cd=20+11=31.
OB 중점은 (5,10). A(−5,5)와 잇는 직선의 기울기는 1/2, 절편은 15/2이므로 ab=15/4.
For a root x, m=(x²−4x)/(2x+1), x∈[−2,2], x≠−1/2. The derivative is 2(x+2)(x−1)/(2x+1)². On [−2,−1/2) the range is (−∞,−4]; on (−1/2,2] it is [−1,∞).

Line AB is x+3y−35=0. Centroid G=(P+A+B)/3 is one third of P’s signed distance from AB because A,B lie on AB. Center (2,3) is at distance 24/√10 from AB; the farthest circle point adds radius 3. Maximum is (24/√10+3)/3=1+8/√10=1+4√10/5.

First inequality for integer a gives x∈{a−2,…,a+2}. If a=1, the second is 0<4 and all five work. If a>1, x<T=3+4/(a−1): a=2 gives all five; a≥3 gives at most four. If a<1, x>T=3−4/(1−a); for a=0 the window −2…2 has only 0,1,2 above −1, and for a≤−1 the count is at most four. Therefore a=1,2.
